about: Real TCAD 2026 certified export records and one real stored Austin permit row for test/travis/shared-files-identity.test.ts. Values are unmodified; only keys are dropped (see projection).

run.coordinates: parcels.latitude / longitude / coordinate_source of this job in the local Query DB (0201_gis)

projection: Each record keeps redact.ts TOP_KEEP keys with owners [] and sales / deeds / valuations reduced by SALE_KEEP / DEED_KEEP / slimValuations (the code's own redacted-record shape), so no owner, party, price, note or inspection reaches Git. record_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the original export text. The permit payload drops contractor_* and applicant* keys (people's names and phones); the Property Improvement shared files never read them.
